name: stack
title: Stack
description: Lay children out in a column or row with one gap from the spacing scale.
a11y: A plain div; adds no roles.

props.name: direction
props.description: `column` (default) stacks children vertically; `row` lays them out horizontally.

props.name: gap
props.description: Step on the spacing scale: 1 = --s1 (4px) up to 9.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines. Useful with `direction="row"`. Default false.
